visual_action: An animated infographic displays a map of the United States under the title "SENATE RACES MIDTERM ELECTIONS: TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2022". States are colored in sequentially, first blue for Democratic-held seats and then red for Republican-held seats. A running tally on screen updates, finishing with 14 Democratic-held seats and 21 Republican-held seats up for election.
